question: Does a new GitLab.com Free account need a card before hosted runners run its first job, or does a low-risk account run on email alone?
why: two first-party pages differ: the pricing FAQ says card details are required to use GitLab.com shared runners, while the identity-verification page and the CI debugging page make the stage depend on an unpublished risk score (email for all, phone for medium-risk, card for high-risk); only a sign-up shows which applies, so the outcome is unverified: behind a sign-up. identity_cost.kind stays card, the conservative reading
